buildCommand: DB="${POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL:-$POSTGRES_URL}"; if [ -n "$DB" ]; then case "$DB" in *\?*) export DATABASE_URL="$DB&connect_timeout=10";; *) export DATABASE_URL="$DB?connect_timeout=10";; esac; echo "[db] host: $(echo $DATABASE_URL | sed 's|.*@||; s|/.*||')"; prisma db push --accept-data-loss --skip-generate || exit 1; fi; next build
